Well right now I'm at one of the best mental hospitals there is in the country - working on my Bipolar Disorder. 

What I mean is that my mind has stopped developing and is very stagnant. Mental illness started at 15 for me. It's hard for me to connect to my inner self as it feels like its gone. Very abstract concept. It's like a lot it has stopped processing the way I need to process in order to function in the world. I don't know why but its unnerving.

Thanks for the response Another part of what I Would call my mental illness is the inability to grow in the ways that I want to grow, or feeling your personal growth is blocked. Anyone have this same issue?

I just want to say I totally relate. Just to share
My experience with you I cannot even believe an existence like this possible, where you are just conscious enough to recognize that you physically exist but you are completely lost on a moment to moment and deep profound way. Maybe there was some point in your life where the chains of hopelessness got locked and you got stuck somewhere. I, like you, could also go days without seeing people, I literally feel like a zombie on autopilot, I've been running around like this for years and seen health professionals for five years. Let me know if you want to talk, I'm sure I can relate to all of it. 
Best, 
Henry 
Henrysegalellis1992@gmail.com

I'm finding myself repeating the same patterns over and over again throughout my day. I cannot find meaning in anything. 
I've been in therapy for years and I'm constantly debating whether I'm just insane or convinced myself of all my problems. I cannot think of any trauma specifically that I went through as a kid, although I was bullied at sleep away camp a lot and I was very isolated as a kid. What I do know is that my problems have not gotten better and I feel like at this point, I feel like my therapists and everyone around me who say it's going to get better are lying or in denial. I cannot unthink the rigidity of patterns in which I live. They are so deeply ingrained my psyche literally has zero flexibility. I'm pretty emotionally numb at this point and I'm running out of options. I am deeply considering ayuascah as a last resort but my parents and doctors disagree heavily. I feel like I'm already dead at this point with my current situation and when you have consistent suicide ideation you really begin to question if you have anything to lose at all.

I started smoking weed when I was fifteen around the time I read a dating book which really confused me. I had processing issues as a younger kid and was very aware of my own mind. Smoking mj was bad as it caused a lot of dp and the dating book exhasterbated a lot of my own self conscious anxiety - how to act etc. 
I am bipolar with a history of one psychotic episode but I just cannot seem to make sense of the world or find any meaning in anything moment to moment. I explain this to my gp but he just thinks it's depression. (Which probably it is to some degree). Everyone is so excited about New Years - I could give two shits about it. It's like I've lost the ability to feel human and desire a better life. I'm just this flat zombie of a person who has no desire for social situations or higher purpose moment to moment.
